seed_rule: Runtime seed must equal 20260801 exactly or strategy construction fails closed.

data_contract.decision_input: canonical RangeIndex DecisionContext bar frames only
data_contract.bar_availability_rule: admit a row only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time; frame index is never a timestamp
data_contract.history_rule: exact contiguous suffix of 253 closed prices on one modal timestamp grid, with latest close no more than 12 hours stale

mechanism.common_tape: cross-sectional median 8h log return of the current eligible native-crypto universe at each past timestamp
mechanism.up_capture: sum(common_return * symbol_return) / sum(common_return^2) on positive common-tape bars
mechanism.down_capture: the same conditional slope on negative common-tape bars
mechanism.score: 0.50 times centered average-rank(up_capture) minus centered average-rank(down_capture)
mechanism.time_order_invariance: paired observations may be permuted without changing the statistic
mechanism.selection: A5-returned score chooses the top and bottom k, where k=min(8,max(5,ceil(0.20*N)))
mechanism.sizing: equal weights with 0.24 long and 0.24 short budgets

universe_authority.rule: Only certified native crypto coins and tokens; stablecoins, equities, TradFi, indexes, metals, commodities, and every other non-crypto contract remain excluded even when exchange-listed as perpetuals.

score_adapter.boundary: complete final finite built-in dict[str,float] after capture transforms and before span checks, selection, role separation, sizing, caps, or organizer risk
score_adapter.label: simple executable-open-to-executable-open return

family_rule: One exact no-control core in pivot-01. No same-family controls, ablations, sign flips, parameter neighbors, or replacement trials are authorized. A failed core terminates this family; any later use of the second pivot requires a separately documented genuinely different mechanism.
private_data_rule: No private or OOS access is authorized until every development and A5 gate passes and the organizer formally selects the candidate.
